sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Bb7]My Father [Eb/G]is rich in houses and lands,
[Eb/Bb]He holdeth the wealth of [Bb]the world in His [Bb7]hands!
[Bb7]Of rubies and [Eb/Bb]diamonds, of silver and gold,
[Bb7]His coffers [Fm/C]are [Ab]full, He [Gm]has riches untold.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Eb]I'm a child of the King,
[Eb]A child of the King:
[Eb/Bb]With Jesus my Savior,
[Bb]I'm a [Eb]child of [Ab]the King.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Bb7]My Father's [Eb/G]own Son, the Savior of men,
[Eb/Bb]Once wandered on earth as [Bb]the poorest of [Bb7]them;
[Bb7]But now He is [Eb/Bb]pleading our pardon on high,
[Bb7]That we [Fm/C]may be [Ab]His when [Gm]He comes by and [Eb]by.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Bb7]I once [Eb/Bb]was an outcast stranger on earth,
[Eb/Bb]A sinner by choice, an [Bb]alien by birth,
[Bb7]But I've been adopted, [Eb/Bb]my name's written down,
[Bb7]An heir [Fm/C]to a [Ab]mansion, [Gm]a robe and a [Eb]crown.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [Bb7]A tent [Eb/Bb]or a cottage, why should I care?
[Eb/Bb]They're building a palace [Bb]for me over [Bb7]there;
[Bb7]Though exiled from [Eb/Bb]home, yet still may I sing:
[Bb7]All glory [Fm/C]to [Ab]God, I'm [Gm]a child of the [Eb]King.
